description:
Community: download the .deb automatically. Enterprise: VERIFY the human-
    placed .deb (returns blocked_on_human with instructions if it's missing).

    Enterprise is licence-gated: before it executes you must pass
    subscription_confirmed=true, which records that the USER affirmed they hold a valid
    Odoo Enterprise subscription for the correct number of users. Confirm this with the
    human first - Zoxron never supplies the Enterprise licence or code.
name: acquire_source
